items.description:
Chery Centurion is a Chery vehicle dealership located at 146 Ivan Avenue, Hennopspark, Pretoria, operating as the brand's official online presence for the Centurion area. The dealership's website lets customers book test drives and explore the current Chery model range sold through the showroom, including the Tiggo 4 Cross HEV, Tiggo 7 PHEV, Tiggo 8 PHEV and Tiggo 9 PHEV, covering hybrid and plug-in hybrid SUV options. Alongside new vehicle sales, the dealership handles enquiries related to vehicle finance, service bookings and accessories for Chery owners in the area.

Chery Centurion also promotes the Chery mobile app, available for Android, Huawei and Apple devices, giving customers an additional way to interact with the brand away from the showroom. As part of the wider Chery South Africa network, the dealership benefits from the manufacturer's national marketing, model launches and after-sales support infrastructure, while still operating as the dedicated point of contact for buyers in the Centurion and greater Pretoria area.

ClearFlow Dialysis Solutions is a Booysens-based supplier and distributor of dialysis consumables, filtration systems and equipment, serving dialysis units and hospital-based acute haemodialysis departments. The business sells filters in bulk, with a minimum order of 24 units per box, making it geared toward healthcare facilities rather than individual patients. ClearFlow operates extended hours to support its logistics: deliveries run from 5am to 6pm, while collections are available 24 hours a day, and the business's general operating hours span 5am to 10pm, including public holidays. This extended availability reflects the nature of its client base, since hospitals and dialysis units often need consumables and equipment replenished outside standard business hours.

Being based in Booysens gives ClearFlow convenient reach into Pretoria's hospital and healthcare-facility network for both delivery and collection services, supporting the ongoing, high-volume consumable needs of acute haemodialysis operations rather than one-off retail purchases.

Click Certain (PTY) LTD is a digital marketing agency based in Eldoraigne, Pretoria, offering an end-to-end service that spans strategy, campaign management, creative design and analytics. The agency positions itself around a results-driven approach, working with clients to build online presence and track measurable performance rather than offering generic one-off marketing tasks. Its Eldoraigne premises include wheelchair accessible parking, making the office reachable for clients visiting in person for consultations. By combining campaign strategy with creative design and ongoing analytics reporting, Click Certain aims to give businesses a clearer view of how their digital marketing spend translates into actual results, rather than simply running campaigns without follow-up measurement.

Operating from Eldoraigne places the agency within reach of businesses across Centurion and the wider Pretoria area that are looking for a dedicated digital marketing partner to manage their online advertising and brand presence on an ongoing basis.

Continental Linen Lynnridge is a home textiles retailer at Lynnridge Mall in Lynnwood Ridge, Pretoria, offering a wide range of linens, towels, carpets and home accents. Its in-store range covers quality bedding, sheets, table linens, towels, carpets and door mats, with staff on hand to help customers choose products suited to their homes. The store accepts in-store card payments and offers a wheelchair accessible entrance and parking, making it reachable for a broad range of shoppers visiting Lynnridge Mall.

As a mall-based retailer, Continental Linen Lynnridge benefits from the regular foot traffic of a shopping centre, and its focus on bedding and home-textile basics makes it a convenient stop for customers doing general home-goods shopping rather than browsing a specialist boutique. Regular in-store deals are also part of its offering, giving repeat shoppers a reason to check back for new stock and promotions.

Control Systems Technology, trading as Consystec, is a Hennopspark-based supplier of industrial measurement and monitoring equipment. The company's product range, organised on its own site into dedicated categories, covers data loggers and recorders, pressure, temperature and humidity sensors, flow measurement equipment, and environmental monitoring instruments. It also supplies electrical measurement equipment, crane safety systems, GSM/SMS communicators for remote alerts, industrial combustion equipment, level sensors, analysis instruments, and associated software for interpreting collected data. This broad catalogue suggests Consystec serves industrial and process-engineering customers who need to monitor conditions such as temperature, humidity, pressure and flow across a site, as well as receive remote alerts when readings fall outside set parameters.

Being based in Hennopspark, Centurion, places the business within reach of the industrial parks and manufacturing operations across the greater Pretoria area that rely on this type of measurement and monitoring instrumentation.

Die Ballon Salon is a balloon decor and party planning business based in Les Marais, Pretoria, focused on creating events that are both stylish and sustainable. The business designs custom balloon setups for a range of occasions, working closely with clients to match the decor to a chosen theme, and also creates exclusive party packs and favours, with packs starting from R75 per child.

Die Ballon Salon states that it uses only biodegradable balloons of high quality, positioning sustainability as a core part of its offering rather than an afterthought added for marketing purposes. By combining relatively affordable pricing with custom design work, the business aims to make attractive balloon decor accessible for private parties and other celebrations across Pretoria, taking care of setup details so clients can focus on hosting rather than decorating.

Dikgomo Banareng TravelInAfrica Agency is a shuttle and airport-transfer operator based in Muckleneuk, Pretoria, listed in the ShuttleScout directory of South African shuttle and transfer services. The operator offers door-to-airport and airport-to-door transfers, giving travellers a dedicated pick-up and drop-off service rather than a shared shuttle route, as well as private point-to-point transfers arranged around the client's own schedule. It lists Pretoria and OR Tambo International Airport in Gauteng among the areas and routes it serves, reflecting the common need for reliable transport between the capital and the country's busiest airport.

Operating from Muckleneuk, a suburb close to central Pretoria, the agency is positioned to serve both business and leisure travellers who need predictable transfers to and from the airport, rather than operating as a general tour or sightseeing company.

items.description:
DistriLiq's Pretoria branch, based in The Willows at Willow Park Manor, is a liquor distributor supplying bulk beverages to bars, restaurants, coffee cafes and event organisers. Its range includes beer, wine, spirits and soft drinks, allowing hospitality businesses to stock a full bar from a single supplier, along with bar equipment such as liquor pourers, cocktail shakers and strainers for making mixed drinks and cocktails. DistriLiq markets its service around a comprehensive product range paired with account management support, aiming to make reordering straightforward for busy venues rather than requiring repeated manual orders each time stock runs low.

The branch forms part of a wider DistriLiq network with other branches in Rustenburg, Cape Town and George, allowing the business to describe itself as a national wholesale beverage supplier operating from several regional bases, including this Pretoria location in The Willows.

Dosma Communications is a Centurion-based company offering branding, printing, web development and mobile communications services. Its Facebook page describes the business as specialising in all of these service areas together, suggesting it positions itself as a single point of contact for businesses that need both printed and digital marketing materials rather than sourcing each separately from different suppliers. A copyright notice on the company's own website indicates it has been operating under the Dosma Communications name since at least 2012. The company maintains an active social media presence to reach clients in the Centurion and wider Pretoria area, including past promotions such as personalised branded masks for customers.

Operating from Kosmosdal places the business within the Samrand Business Park area, convenient for serving corporate clients across Centurion who need branding, print and web services handled together.

items.description:
Eaglehouse Property Group is a diversified South African property owner and operator based in Magalieskruin, Pretoria, focused on long-term value creation across residential, agricultural and commercial asset classes. Since 2018 the company has built a portfolio that includes family-oriented homes in secure gated communities and standalone houses for buyers wanting more space, alongside agricultural properties that support emerging medium-scale farmers in crop and poultry production. The portfolio also extends to self-storage developments, responding to rising demand for extra storage space from households and small businesses. Eaglehouse Property Group describes itself as founder-led, with its leadership holding an MBA in Engineering Management and an Executive MBA specialising in Logistics and Supply Chain Leadership, bringing a systems-driven approach to portfolio strategy, risk management and operational efficiency.

Based in Magalieskruin, the group manages this mixed portfolio of residential, agricultural and storage assets across the wider Gauteng region.

Edgars is a South African department store chain selling clothing, footwear and accessories, with this branch located at Shop 126 in Irene Village Mall, Irene Farm Villages, Centurion. As with other Edgars branches, the store regularly runs promotional catalogues and seasonal sales covering its clothing, footwear and accessories ranges, giving shoppers at Irene Village Mall access to the same nationwide offers available at other branches around the country.

Positioned within Irene Village Mall alongside other retailers, the store benefits from the mall's general foot traffic from shoppers living in the surrounding Centurion residential areas. As a mall-based branch of a national chain, it follows standard Edgars trading hours and stock ranges rather than operating as an independent outlet, giving local shoppers the convenience of a familiar retailer close to home.

Elmarie Van Heerden Attorneys is a Waverley-based law firm listed on the Procompare directory of South African legal service providers. The firm's listed areas of practice cover family and divorce law, labour law, corporate and commercial law, immigration law, and conveyancing, indicating a general civil-law practice rather than a narrow specialisation in a single area. Being listed as handling both family and commercial matters means the firm is positioned to assist individual clients with issues such as divorce, as well as businesses needing corporate, commercial or employment-law advice. Conveyancing work additionally points to involvement in property transfers for clients buying or selling property in and around Pretoria.

Based in Waverley, the firm serves clients across the wider Pretoria area, offering a broad enough range of services that most general legal needs can be handled without referring clients elsewhere.

items.description:
Entelect is a software engineering company offering end-to-end technology services, from strategy and design through to development, testing and rollout, with its Centurion office based at Southdowns Ridge Office Park. The company works across a wide range of industries, including agriculture, banking, education, energy, financial services, healthcare, insurance, logistics, media, mining and manufacturing, retail and consumer services, technology and telecommunications, reflecting a focus on custom software rather than a single vertical. Entelect lists partnerships with major technology vendors including Amazon Web Services, Sitecore, Backbase, Microsoft Azure and Salesforce, which it draws on when building and integrating client solutions. The company describes itself as a culture-first organisation that places emphasis on its people and client relationships alongside technical delivery.

From its Centurion office, Entelect provides regional clients with access to this broader national software engineering and consulting practice.

Epic Escapades (Pty) Ltd is a travel agency based in Hesteapark, Pretoria, accredited with SA Tourism and offering customised travel packages across South Africa and internationally. The agency specialises in tailored tours covering adventure, nature, culture and educational travel, aiming to combine affordable pricing with premium service rather than offering only budget or only luxury options. Its green travel focus includes partnering with eco-conscious operators, positioning the business around more sustainable tourism alongside standard wildlife safaris and cultural journeys.

Beyond booking holidays, Epic Escapades also handles business travel arrangements, event management and school trips, and offers value-added services such as catering, event photography and a travel clinic for travel vaccinations, making it a broader travel-services provider rather than only a booking agent. The agency promotes round-the-clock online support for clients planning trips, covering transportation, accommodation, guided tours and event logistics for families, solo travellers and corporate groups alike.

items.description:
Etienne Loots Attorney / Prokureur is a Sinoville-based law practice that has operated under this name since 2003. The firm's services span labour and employment law, litigation, corporate law, conveyancing, divorce and family law, criminal law, debt services, wills and estates, and liquidation, sequestration and rehabilitation matters, giving it a broad general practice rather than a single specialisation. Its labour and employment law work covers advice to both employers and employees navigating South Africa's labour legislation, while its litigation practice is built around finding a tailored strategy for each client's dispute rather than applying the same approach to every matter. The estates and wills service covers drafting valid wills to help clients protect their legacy, and the firm's corporate law work focuses on simplifying governance matters for business clients.

Operating from Sinoville, the practice serves individual and business clients across the northern parts of Pretoria.

Event Wizards has organised corporate and private events from its base in the Waterkloof Park area of Pretoria since 2004, working with thousands of businesses and event organisers in South Africa and abroad over that time. The company's services cover full event management alongside audio-visual and technical support, catering, decor and design, and furniture hire for functions of varying scale. It also offers MICE services, covering meetings, incentives, conferences and exhibitions for corporate clients, as well as plant rental for decorating and dressing event spaces. Event Wizards positions its offering around planning events that run smoothly from a technical and logistical standpoint, while also handling the visual design side through its decor and furniture services.

Based in Pretoria, the company serves clients across the city who need event planning handled by a single provider rather than coordinating several separate suppliers themselves.

Fairos Business Consultants, established in January 2012, is a Sinoville-based firm that helps South African businesses navigate the B-BBEE compliance process. Its services include assistance with Employment Equity plans, Skills Development reporting and Workplace Skills Plan submissions, registration and implementation of accredited Learnerships, and advice on ownership restructuring to support a company's B-BBEE scorecard. The firm positions its approach around designing a plan tailored to each client's existing culture and operations, rather than applying a single standard template across all businesses, since B-BBEE requirements can affect companies differently depending on their size and sector. By supporting clients through the full verification process, Fairos aims to help businesses score effectively under B-BBEE legislation while meeting the related employment-equity and skills-development reporting obligations.

The firm operates from Sinoville, assisting businesses across the Pretoria region with these compliance requirements.

items.description:
Financeium School of Business is an online business school based in the Olympus area of Pretoria, offering business and finance courses alongside business coaching programmes. Its courses are designed for flexible, self-paced learning, allowing students to study around work and other commitments rather than following a fixed classroom schedule, and enrolment is handled through an online process.

Beyond structured courses, the school offers consulting and coaching services, commissioned research and publishing, extending its activities beyond teaching alone. Among its programmes are BANKSETA-accredited offerings such as a financial wellness course and a financial management course, pointing to a focus on practical, accredited financial-literacy training alongside broader business and leadership topics. Financeium positions its education as globally contextual while aimed at solving local business challenges, delivering its programmes to students in Pretoria and more widely through its online platform.

FinFix Shared Services (Pty) Ltd is an NCR-registered debt counselling and debt review company based in Lynnwood Manor, Pretoria. Its core services are built around reducing monthly payments, consolidating multiple debts into a single structured plan, and protecting assets from attachment or repossession during the debt-review process. The company offers a free, no-obligation assessment to prospective clients before they commit to formal debt counselling, letting people understand their options before entering a structured repayment plan. As an NCR-registered counsellor, FinFix operates within the formal debt-review framework set out under South African credit legislation, rather than offering informal debt-management advice.

Based in Lynnwood Manor, the company works with individuals across Pretoria and more broadly who are looking to restructure unmanageable debt into a single, more sustainable repayment arrangement over time.

Fleisherei Deli is a butchery and delicatessen at Hazeldean Square in Pretoria, part of the wider Fleisherei chain, which has been producing biltong since 2003. Across the group, Fleisherei operates seven meat delis, eight biltong outlets, a liquor store and an online butchery, alongside wholesale and bulk supply to major retailers and co-packing and private-labelling services for other brands' biltong, fresh meat and cured products.

At the Hazeldean Square branch, customers can buy traditionally made biltong and fresh meat cuts in person, drawing on the same production standards the group applies to its wholesale and retail supply more broadly. Being part of a larger group with its own co-packing facilities allows the Hazeldean Square deli to offer a wide range of biltong and meat products at the counter rather than operating as a small independent butchery with a limited range of stock.

Food Lover's Market Nkomo Village is a branch of the Food Lover's Market fresh-produce and grocery chain, located in Nkomo Village Shopping Centre in Atteridgeville. The store includes an in-house bakery, butchery and deli counter, and offers Halaal product options alongside its general grocery range. Facilities at the branch include on-site parking and wheelchair-friendly access, making the store reachable for a broad range of shoppers in the Atteridgeville area. Trading hours run from early morning through to 8pm daily, giving customers an extended window for shopping compared with smaller local grocers in the same area.

As a mall-based branch within Nkomo Village Shopping Centre, the store benefits from combined foot traffic with other retailers at the centre while offering the fresh produce, bakery and butchery sections typical of the wider Food Lover's Market chain.

items.description:
Fox Group CC is a metal-fabrication business in Sunderland Ridge, Centurion, manufacturing individual, custom-made metal parts and components as well as combined assemblies for specialised applications. Its production capabilities include laser cutting supported by dedicated software, machining using modern equipment that runs continuously to support mass production, bending using a range of press brakes suited to different specifications and budgets, and punching for further mass-production work. Finished components are professionally assembled, finished, packed, boxed and distributed from the company's own premises rather than being handed off to a separate assembly contractor. Fox Group holds Level 2 B-BBEE contributor status with a 125% procurement recognition level, which it highlights as part of an economic empowerment policy aimed at passing procurement benefits on to its customers.

Based in Sunderland Ridge, the business serves industrial and manufacturing clients across the greater Centurion area who need custom metal components made to specification.

Techno Tents is a tent and marquee manufacturer based in Pretoria Central, established almost two decades ago and supplying frame tents, peg-and-pole tents, stretch tents, clear frame tents, alpine tents, aluminium tents and pagoda tents for weddings, events and industrial use. The company's range also extends to storage warehouse tents for commercial clients and canvas camping products including bow tents and safari lodge-style tents. Techno Tents positions its products around competitive pricing without compromising on manufacturing quality, stating that all marquees and tents are built to the same standard regardless of price point. The company has set up a dedicated department to handle delivery, after-sales support and customer care, aiming to support clients through the full process from ordering to event setup rather than ending its involvement at the point of sale.

Serving Pretoria and the wider Gauteng region, Techno Tents supplies both one-off event hire clients and businesses needing tents for ongoing commercial or industrial use.

FTTX-Africa, trading as FTTX Africa Broadband Telecommunications (Pty) Ltd, is a telecommunications infrastructure business in Villieria, Pretoria, focused on planning and installing fibre-to-the-x (FTTx) optical network solutions. The company positions its work as part of a broader Rapid Fibre Deployment Strategy, partnering with institutions and broadband providers to extend fibre infrastructure for both private and public-sector clients. Its services include outside plant cabling installations, which cover the physical fibre routes needed to connect network infrastructure to end users or buildings. The business states that its personnel have more than 15 years of combined experience in structured infrastructure solutions, built up through partnerships with established industry brands. FTTX-Africa aims to be recognised as a leading broadband telecommunications solutions provider across South Africa and the wider African continent.

Operating from Villieria, the company supports fibre network rollouts for institutional and broadband-partner clients across the region.

Galaxy Computers is a computer retailer and wholesaler based in Erasmia, Pretoria, selling computers, hardware, software, laptops, security systems and other accessories to both individual and business customers. The company markets itself as offering solutions geared toward load-shedding, suggesting its product range extends into backup power or related equipment alongside standard computer hardware, which is a relevant concern for customers dealing with regular power interruptions. Positioned as a retailer and wholesaler rather than a single-item specialist, Galaxy Computers appears to serve customers looking to buy equipment in volume as well as those purchasing single items for home or office use.

Based in Erasmia, the business serves the western side of Pretoria and Centurion, giving local customers and businesses a nearby source for computer hardware and related accessories without having to travel further into the city.
